run_scripts.merge_three_datasets
================================

.. py:module:: run_scripts.merge_three_datasets

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Create the All-PPGs dataset by merging the three IEB datasets and copying the PPG SIGMF files.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   run_scripts.merge_three_datasets.DATASET_ROOT_OUTPUT


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   run_scripts.merge_three_datasets.resample_signal
   run_scripts.merge_three_datasets.copy_ppg_sigmf_files
   run_scripts.merge_three_datasets.merge_ppg_datasets


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: resample_signal(data, original_fs, target_fs)

   Resample the signal to the target sampling frequency.

   :param data: numpy array of shape (n_samples,)
   :param original_fs: original sampling frequency
   :param target_fs: target sampling frequency

   :returns: numpy array of shape (new_n_samples,)
   :rtype: resampled_data


.. py:function:: copy_ppg_sigmf_files(merged_csv: str, original_data_root: str = '../original data', output_dataset: str = '../original data/all_datasets')

   Copy all PPG SIGMF files referenced in the merged CSV.

   For each row, copies both
       *.sigmf-data
       *.sigmf-meta

   while preserving the relative directory structure.


.. py:function:: merge_ppg_datasets(output_csv: str = 'merged_ppg_dataset.csv') -> pandas.DataFrame

   Merge the PPG entries from the three IEB datasets into a single CSV.

   Output columns:
       file_id
       participant_id
       relative_path
       modality
       session_id
       datetime
       GLC
       dataset


.. py:data:: DATASET_ROOT_OUTPUT
